verdicts.flaw_description: The purchase counts "cover the sessions that reached the new page" while "a quarter of each segment dropped out before checkout", so the 4-7 percent lift is measured only on the surviving three-quarters of each segment rather than on the segment the claim is about.

"The figures cover the runs with the upgraded filter in service" but "a quarter of each stack's runs were made with the filter bypassed", so the 8-14 percent reductions describe only the three-quarters of runs on the filter, not the stack's particulate output that the claim is about.

"Pollen counts in each group's district ran a fifth below the previous quarter, and every group lived and slept on the district's outside air" - a 20 percent drop in pollen exposure reaching all four groups is an alternative cause of the 4-7 fewer attacks that fits every case.

"Averages cover the patients who kept up the home exercises" while "a quarter of each intake let the home exercises lapse", so the 9-16 degree gains are computed on the compliant three-quarters only and cover a narrower population than the intakes put through the protocol.

"Rates cover the trays sown from seed that took a full coat" while "about a fifth of each lot's trays were sown from partly coated seed", so the 6-11 point germination gains exclude a fifth of each lot and describe a narrower population than the coated lots the claim is about.

"Rates cover the boards soldered on the new profile throughout" while "about a tenth of each run's boards took one pass on the old profile", so the 4-7 percent defect reductions are measured on a selected subset of each run rather than on the run's output as a whole.
